notes: Myntra top-level nav (Men/Women/Kids/Home/Genz) and the Home & Living mega-menu (myntra.com/shop/home-living, myntra.com/home-furnishing) contain ZERO pet-related entries - grep for /\bpet\b/i and /\bdog\b/i across the full rendered homepage HTML and the home-furnishing unfiltered listing (which carries Myntra's full 270-value master Categories facet used in the prior Home-Decor pass) returned no matches. So Pet Care is NOT reachable from the nav path documented in notes/222.md. However Myntra DOES run a real, populated 'Pet Supplies' merchandising category not linked from the desktop web nav (findable via direct URL only): https://www.myntra.com/pet-supplies (aliases https://www.myntra.com/pet-care and https://www.myntra.com/pet-accessories return byte-identical pageTitle 'Pet Supplies' and identical totalCount=1685 and identical Categories-facet breakdown - confirmed same taxonomy node, used /pet-supplies as canonical link). EXACT qty source: same mechanism as the prior Home-Decor pass - window.__myx.searchData.results.totalCount embedded in SSR HTML, both on the unfiltered page and on each Categories-filtered PLP (https://www.myntra.com/pet-supplies?f=Categories:<value>). Validated additivity: summed all 34 Categories facet values from the unfiltered /pet-supplies page = 1685, exactly matching the page's own totalCount (no gap, no residual 'Other' bucket). Spot-verified 5 of 34 leaf values by loading each filtered URL directly and re-reading totalCount from that page's own __myx blob (Dog Dresses=394, Pet Beds=1, Pet Crates and Carriers=11, Pet Diapers=8, Pet Stain and Odour Control=2) - all matched the facet-list count exactly, confirming the facet counts are the same exact backend counts as the rendered page, not inflated. SITE TRAP - excluded as unreliable: dedicated short slugs like /pet-bed, /pet-beds, /dog-leash, /pet-bowl, /pets, /petcare (no hyphen) all return HTTP 200 with plausible-looking pageTitles auto-generated from the slug text itself (e.g. /petcare renders pageTitle 'Peter' - a fuzzy-search correction, not a real category), and their totalCounts do NOT match the corresponding Categories-facet value inside the real Pet Supplies category (e.g. /pet-bed and /pet-beds report 82 and 79 products but the verified in-category 'Pet Beds' facet is only 1 product - these auto-slug pages are free-text search landing pages scoped to the whole catalog, not the Pet Care category, and were NOT used as sources). All 34 leaf category names in the Categories facet are Pet-Supplies-native (Dog Dresses/Tshirts/Raincoats/Sweaters/Jackets/Shirts/Sweatshirts = pet clothing; Pet Toys/Collars/Bandanas/Harnesses/Leashes/Bows and Ties/Shoes/Socks = walking+clothing+toys; Pet Mats/Bowls/Feeders/Beds/Blankets/Crates and Carriers/Travel Gear = feeding+beds+travel; Pet Brushes and Combs/Shampoos/Conditioners/Towels/Wipes/Deodorants/Perfumes/Paw Creams = grooming; Pet Scratchers = enrichment; Pet Diapers/Training Pads/Stain and Odour Control = hygiene). No pet food/treat/supplement category and no medical/veterinary category present anywhere in this facet list, so neither open policy-gap flag applies. No zero-qty categories present (all 34 facet values are >=1, none dropped). Single grouping row 'Pet Supplies' emitted as is_group:true (qty/link null) with all 34 leaves as children in descending-count reading order.
